verdict.rationale: RudderStack's own warehouse destinations load event data into the customer's own warehouse under a predefined schema, and its docs say data is stored on your own infrastructure. A self-hostable open-source version also exists, so event data stays under the user's control. The pack has no documented 'export everything' capability, no stated open file formats, and no evidence that workspace configuration (transformations, tracking plans, connections) can be bulk-exported. missing for 10: explicit full-account data/config export tooling, documented open export formats (e.g. CSV/Parquet/JSON), offboarding guidance, independent hands-on corroboration of leaving cleanly.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Store data on your own infrastructure, not ours.
RudderStack automatically does that for you by following a predefined warehouse schema
The open source version of RudderStack is a standalone system dependent only on a database (PostgreSQL)
